text:
olga_payables: morning  invoice 2026-7721 from Pawel (PL) flagged. Vendor invoices for a software license (one-time) and is asking for net payment with Redwood grossing up for any Polish withholding tax. invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-7721.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-7721 flagged: VAT ID PL9876543210 present, missing TRC and gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

pawel_vendor: hi team, correct. we're Polish company (Sp. z o.o.), VAT PL9876543210. contract clause 7.2 says "vendor to be made whole" for withholding. we prefer net payment; please advise what evidence you need.

marta_tax: quick clarifier: software license typically treated as royalties or supply of goods/services? for EU B2B cross-border it may be outside scope VAT (reverse charge) but withholding on royalties is separate. need to confirm nature.

cam_sales: sales confirms it's a perpetual software license (IP transfer-ish) rather than recurring SaaS. contract ambiguous.

olga_payables: action items: (1) vendor to upload TRC or Polish tax residency certificate (2) legal to confirm whether contract implies gross-up obligation (3) tax to confirm whether withholding applies to these payments and rate if any (4) verify bank details.

pawel_vendor: uploaded files: VAT_cert_PL_9876543210.pdf and BankDetails_PL_7721.pdf. can provide TRC if needed but thought VAT cert was enough.

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: VAT_cert_PL_9876543210.pdf, BankDetails_PL_7721.pdf by pawel_vendor

marta_tax: VAT cert fine for VAT purposes but TRC is needed to show Polish tax residency for treaty consideration. Important: Poland-US treaty may reduce withholding on royalties, but we need TRC + signed declaration. Also need to confirm if payment is actually "royalty" under tax code.

cam_sales: client says license is transfer of IP rights in some jurisdictions. that suggests royalty treatment in parts. legal, can you weigh in?

olga_payables: Please paste last 4 of IBAN for matching.

pawel_vendor: IBAN ****1111 (mBank Poland)

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by olga_payables

marta_tax: preliminary guidance: if treated as royalty and no TRC/treaty, domestic withholding could be 20% under Polish law on outbound payments to nonresidents. if TRC shows Polish resident and US treaty applies (or other jurisdiction), rate may be reduced. But because vendor is invoicing from PL entity with PL bank, likely Polish resident; we still need TRC to be safe. We need legal to confirm classification as royalty vs sale of goods.

olga_payables: legal ask sent. holding payment. finance won't gross-up automatically; if contract requires gross-up, legal must confirm and finance needs an explicit gross-up addendum signed with calculation.

pawel_vendor: i can provide TRC and signed gross-up addendum. we'll upload both. please advise documentation format for TRC (Polish certificate of residency?).

marta_tax: TRC from Polish tax office (potwierdzenie rezydencji) or equivalent is fine. also vendor signature on gross-up addendum must define whether gross-up covers employer taxes or only withholding.

olga_payables: tagging finance-approvals if gross-up needed due to budget impact.

[later same thread]

invoice-bot: New file uploaded: TRC_PL_7721.pdf by pawal_vendor

pawel_vendor: Grossup_Addendum_signed_7721.pdf uploaded as well.

marta_tax: offline note: tax reviewed TRC and docs. TRC confirms Polish residency; classification still ambiguous but leaning to royalty treatment in some jurisdictions. If royalty and no treaty reduction to 0%, domestic withholding may apply. Tax recommends we request a signed declaration describing source of income and then legal to confirm contract.

olga_payables: summary: TRC + addendum received. Legal to confirm obligation to gross-up and signoff required for payment release. Holding payment for 48hrs pending legal.

invoice-bot: Thread note: "TRC & gross-up addendum received; legal review pending; payment ON_HOLD."
